content: {"summary":"On 11 December 2025 SSH to inventory-db-01 failed to write shell history because the root disk’s /var partition was 100 % full. The fullness was caused by the systemd journal growing without a size limit, filling /var/log/journal. The issue was resolved by vacuum‑ing the journal and adding a size limit (SystemMaxUse=500M) to journald.conf.","likely_cause":"Unbounded systemd journal logs (no size limit in journald.conf) filled /var, causing ENOSPC errors.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"/var was 100 % full, causing ENOSPC errors","evidence_ids":["INC-0109#0"],"quote":"df -h /var on the host, 100%."},{"text":"Journald had no size setting, allowing logs to fill /var","evidence_ids":["INC-0109#1"],"quote":"journald.conf on this host had no size setting at all."},{"text":"Vacuuming the journal and setting SystemMaxUse=500M cleared space","evidence_ids":["INC-0109#1"],"quote":"added `SystemMaxUse=500M` to `/etc/systemd/journald.conf`"}],"next_checks":["Check other VMs for missing journald size limits","Add monitoring alerts for /var usage thresholds","Verify that SystemMaxUse is set on all hosts"]}
